name: mirage
text: v1.0.17 is released: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.17 . Engine tab > Money now has a separate Kalshi card (wallet, open bets, bids resting, placed today, settled). On your no-bids problem I can't see your phone, so I'm adding a plain-words reason (no key saved / orders off / not scanned yet / what the bid rules held back) to that Kalshi card and the Bids page, shipping next as v1.0.18. Meanwhile: after turning the toggles on, pull to refresh on +EV with Kalshi on so a Kalshi scan exists; bids are made from the last Kalshi scan.
